metadata.title: TradeCheck
metadata.description: Multilingual pre-shipment check for commercial invoices, packing lists and purchase orders.

footer.notice: For information only — not official customs or legal advice.
footer.positioning: TradeCheck is a pre-shipment check you run yourself. It does not replace a customs broker or professional advice.

home.title: Checks
home.emptyBody: Start one by adding the documents for a shipment.

newCheck.title: New check
newCheck.intro: Add the commercial invoice, packing list and purchase order for one shipment. TradeCheck reads them, compares them and lists what needs attention, with the evidence from each document.

upload.limits: PDF, PNG or JPG · up to {maxMb} MB per file · up to {maxPages} pages per PDF · up to {maxFiles} files per check
upload.privacy: Files are deleted automatically after {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. You can delete them sooner at any time.

permission.apiKeyMissingTitle: Document reading is not set up
permission.apiKeyMissingBody: The server has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, so documents cannot be read yet. The operator can add it as described in the README.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist, or the check it belonged to has been deleted.
